scripts.deploy:pages:prod: npm run test:performance && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name cameronaaronsite --branch=master
scripts.test:performance: npm run build && npm run test:performance:contracts && npx @lhci/cli@0.15.1 autorun --config=lighthouserc.json
scripts.test:modularization: sh -c 'vitest run src/modularization-contract.test.ts src/module-testability-contract.test.ts $(find src/components -type f \( -name logic.test.ts -o -name \*-logic.test.ts -o -name engine.test.ts -o -name builders.test.ts \) | sort) src/components/projects/FeaturedIcon.test.tsx src/components/contact/SocialPlatformIcon.test.tsx src/components/ui/brain-cursor.test.tsx src/components/ui/floating-badge-icon.test.tsx src/components/ui/section-transitions.test.tsx'
scripts.test:a11y:contracts: vitest run src/app/wcag-contract.test.tsx src/app/a11y-regressions.test.tsx src/components/sections-a11y.test.tsx src/components/navigation-a11y.test.tsx src/components/faq-a11y.test.tsx src/components/ui/keyboard-shortcuts.test.tsx
scripts.test:a11y:automated: npm run test:a11y:contracts && npm run test:a11y:scanners
scripts.test:a11y:ci: npm run test:a11y:contracts && npm run test:a11y:scanners && npm run test:a11y:external
scripts.seo:audit: npm run build && npm run seo:check && npx @lhci/cli@0.15.1 autorun --config=lighthouserc.json
